risks.title: Dependence on economic cycles and customer demand
risks.score_rationale: Major risk explicitly mentioned in Item 1A (A.8.1.2). Intensive language: "important customer industries for Siemens are suffering from effects" and "many headwinds for Siemens' market environment". Trend: stable/up (COVID-19 persistent). Weight: affects all segments (Digital Industries, Smart Infrastructure, Mobility).

risks.title: Global supply chain risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in A.8.1.1: "no significant disruptions in global supply chains have been observed" (negative formulation suggesting concern). Moderate language but present. Trend: stable (no disruptions currently but latent risk). Weight: relevant for a global industrial manufacturer.

risks.title: Exposure to currency risks (USD, GBP, emerging market currencies)
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly detailed in A.8.1.2: "We are exposed to currency translation effects, mainly involving the U.S. dollar, the British pound and currencies of emerging markets". Clear and specific language. Trend: up (2021 forecast: "negative currency effects will strongly burden both nominal growth rates"). Weight: direct impact on EBITA and growth.

risks.title: Intense competition and margin pressure
risks.score_rationale: Implicit but strong in performance data: adjusted EBITA margin of 14.3% (vs 14.4% prior year), with Smart Infrastructure and Siemens Healthineers below their long-term target ranges (9.1% and 15.1% vs long-term objectives). Language: "cost structure improvement and competitiveness programs" with severance charges of 0.5 billion €. Trend: stable/down. Weight: affects profitability.

risks.title: Regulatory and legal risks (Varian acquisition, Valeo)
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in A.8.1.2: "Excluded from this outlook are burdens from legal and regulatory issues and effects in connection with Siemens Healthineers' planned acquisition of Varian". Explicit language of risk exclusion. Trend: new/up (acquisition in progress, closing H1 2021). Weight: potential impact on Healthineers net income.

risks.title: Dependence on digital transformation and industrial IoT
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in A.7: "The pandemic has increased activity in the digital economy and underscored the need for digitalization and the development of the industrial internet of things. These are core competencies of Siemens". Positive language but reveals strategic dependence. Trend: up (opportunity but also disruption risk). Weight: transversal to all segments.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks (US-China, Brexit, US elections)
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited in A.8.1.1: "High uncertainty also applies to significant political developments, such as the U.S.-China trade relationship and the U.K.'s exit from the EU, as well as to the longer-term outcome of the 2020 U.S. election cycle". Clear language of uncertainty. Trend: stable/up (persistent tensions). Weight: affects supply chain and key markets.

risks.title: Credit risks and performance guarantees (€28.5 billion)
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in off-balance sheet commitments section: "maximum potential future payments related primarily to credit and performance guarantees amounted to €28.5 billion". Factual language. Trend: stable (including Siemens Energy reimbursement rights). Weight: balance sheet risk but partially covered.
